purpose: supported raw expression facts -> finite representation predicate projection -> unchanged contract evaluator; known development only
support: unsigned width8/16/32/64; explicit storage and host byteorder; field raw/to_host; constant-mask bit existence and zero/nonzero only
proof: strict permutation+constant-mask predicate family; compare accepted semantic bit support for universal finite-width equivalence, otherwise provide a basis-bit counterexample; not arbitrary C or runtime proof
source_boundary: manual site/field/struct selection; complete selected local expression parsed; constants and byteorder registry externally sourced/reviewed; no interprocedural alias or effective preprocessor proof
unified_core: contract_protocol.py unchanged; only relation at generated sample is compared, no actual content-consumption value or whole path
record_basis: synthetic, allow_synthetic=True; real source references do not make generated scalar values real observations

meaningful_tests: zero/symmetric masks, matched or wrong conversion placement
preregistered_validation.baseline_development_expectations: separate file, not fed as analyzer answers
core_controls: promote sample to actual-use event without review

execution_rule: save method snapshot/complete inputs and independent pre-review before first component/test execution; retain any failure and exact changed inputs/method separately on repair
